effective_plan.transformation: Use source facts to derive a bounded reusable CFG: original fresh source graph, reusable copies of the root/header/dispatcher and exact post-store tail path, plus a finite point-producer/sole-write rendezvous. Both headers retain original exact funding/debits/phase counters. Fresh finite evaluation fills only F64 cache data and enters the rendezvous; reusable evaluation uses previous read data under source-derived current-column upper/checked-overflow guards, then fills F64 data and joins that same write. Original old-first/no-op/COW semantics stay. Private/no-op completion follows the proved tail into reusable header. Original lexical fallback and COW completion follow fresh tail/header; every other latch edge targets fresh. No runtime validity/pending/column token or permission crosses a call. Original sources/fees/first errors/F64 tree/outputs/aliases stay.

Rolling eligibility requires source-proved same-row checked column+1 post-store continuation of this exact updated matrix, single tracked matrix mutation, fixed affine offsets in both source axes, bounded source steps/keys and a single source-observed F64 result. Every other latch entry invalidates; any cold numeric reentry starts empty. Read reuse cannot cross an unproved mutation, phase/owner boundary or reshape. Only the last successfully completed store result can replace the overwritten center.

A fresh point retains complete checked U64 intermediate/row/column admission before any load. Consecutive-point reuse proves unchanged row expressions and shifted-by-one column expressions; retain upper/overflow guards for all source checked subexpressions, including unused ones. Current full geometry/epoch/span/capacity/schema/owner admission stays. Static axes only from the existing exact source witness and never appending views. No global readonly/alias/alignment claims.

Original separate scalar F64 operands/tree/term order/rounding remain; no reassociation,FMA,reciprocal substitution or independent SIMD of dependent outputs. Preserve source first failures, no-op/COW order, aliases, atomic previous external output, finite denials and cleanup/retry.

All execution counters exactly match accepted59; no source work/comparison/visit/bill reduction or padding. A reused point has prior token<columns, so exact source unit-column continuation stages previous+1 in1..columns. No observer can reenter prefix between staging and the sole store; source errors exit the native loan, and COW clears token before its original call. Thus early private staging cannot authorize an uncompleted source write. Source source/read/CFG witnesses remain private and rederived; no new external authority.

Control-flow context is compiler-private and rederived from same-plan facts. Reusable entries are reachable only from successful finite producer plus completed original private/no-op write along the exact same-bank/same-row/checked unit-column source tail. COW, original lexical evaluation, every other latch, loan entry/reentry and source errors cannot enter reusable context. Fresh source still runs complete original preflight. Reusable bounds inherit prior complete row/lower validity and guard every advancing column checked intermediate against overflow plus current maximum read column against current columns before any load. F64 cache values are defined on each finite producer and never needed across COW/fresh edges. No integer cache word is read or updated in the CFG path.
